notes: Pilot pilot-bbu2-v2 (BH/RS seeds 0-9, 60k steps). NEP89 GM = C15 Laves MgCu2 (the experimental ground state; Cu [Cu6Mg6], Mg [Cu12Mg4]), -3.59952 eV/atom, equal to the relaxed C15 reference; runs that found it agree within 2 meV. C14 is +6 meV/cell (also inside e_tol), C11b +0.77, C32 +1.00 eV/cell, hcp Mg + fcc Cu +1.65 eV/cell. Failed runs (2/10 BH, 2/10 RS) ended +0.57 to +0.77 eV above the GM.
